input.title: review: simplify trigger and reference
input.body: Use a normal pull_request trigger and track main for the toolkit.

files.patch:
--- a/.github/workflows/review.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/review.yml
@@ -1,7 +1,7 @@
 name: review
 on:
-  pull_request_target:
+  pull_request:
     branches: [main]
 jobs:
   review:
@@ -9,7 +9,7 @@ jobs:
     steps:
-      - uses: some-org/ai-review@c0ffee1111111111111111111111111111111111
+      - uses: some-org/ai-review@main
         with:
-          toolkit_ref: c0ffee1111111111111111111111111111111111
+          toolkit_ref: main
         secrets:
           LLM_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.LLM_API_KEY }}

note: Miss #2: pull_request + secret executes PR-head workflow code with the credential; floating ref defeats immutable-supply-chain review.
